hindi: आगे, हे शुद्ध होने वाले, तुम्हारी अश्विन् धेनुएँ, दिव्य, दूध के साथ धारण-स्थान में छोड़ी गईं; आगे अन्तरिक्ष से तुम्हारी स्थिर छोड़ी गईं; जो तुम्हें शुद्ध करते हैं, वे श्रद्धालु।
english: Forth, O clarifying one, your Aśvin milch-cows, heavenly, were released with milk in the holding-place; forth from the atmosphere your firm ones were released; the devout ones who cleanse you, O ṛṣiṣāṇa [unclear].
notes: ta is te before a vowel by regular Vedic sandhi (te + ā gives ta ā). āśvinīḥ is read 'belonging to the Aśvins'; dharīmaṇi 'holding-place' is uncertain. sthāvirīḥ te: the referent of the firm ones is not stated; Hindi leaves it unspecified as in the Sanskrit. ṛṣiṣāṇa is obscure (not translated in Hindi, [unclear] in English); ye ... vedhasaḥ taken as the devout ones who cleanse the clarifying one. Low confidence.
lines_deva: प्र त आश्विनीः पवमान धेनवो दिव्या असृग्रन्पयसा धरीमणि
प्रान्तरिक्षात्स्थाविरीस्ते असृक्षत ये त्वा मृजन्त्यृषिषाण वेधसः
lines_iast: pra ta āśvinīḥ pavamāna dhenavo divyā asṛgranpayasā dharīmaṇi
prāntarikṣātsthāvirīste asṛkṣata ye tvā mṛjantyṛṣiṣāṇa vedhasaḥ

hindi: दोनों ओर शुद्ध होने वाले के, दृढ़, विद्यमान के, किरणें, ध्वज चारों ओर जाते हैं। जब भूरा छन्ने पर शुद्ध किया जाता है, तब आसन में बैठकर कलशों में बैठता है।
english: On both sides the rays, the banners, of the clarifying one, firm, existing, go around. When the tawny one is cleansed on the filter, having sat in the seat, he sits down in the vessels.
notes: sattā is taken as a form of the absolutive 'having sat' (sattvā); the form is unusual. yadī = yad + ī (particle, not translated). ketavaḥ in apposition to raśmayaḥ.
lines_deva: उभयतः पवमानस्य रश्मयो ध्रुवस्य सतः परि यन्ति केतवः
यदी पवित्रे अधि मृज्यते हरिः सत्ता नि योनौ कलशेषु सीदति
lines_iast: ubhayataḥ pavamānasya raśmayo dhruvasya sataḥ pari yanti ketavaḥ
yadī pavitre adhi mṛjyate hariḥ sattā ni yonau kalaśeṣu sīdati

hindi: हे सब देखने वाले, तुम्हारे, कुशल विद्यमान स्वामी के, ध्वज सब धामों के चारों ओर जाते हैं। व्याप्त होते हुए तुम विधान से शुद्ध होकर बहते हो, हे सोम; तुम समस्त भुवन के स्वामी होकर राज करते हो।
english: O all-seeing one, the banners of you, of the skilful, existing lord, go around all the realms. Pervading, you flow clear, O Soma, by the ordinance; as lord of the whole world you reign.
notes: ṛbhvasaḥ te prabhoḥ sataḥ taken as genitives in agreement with te (the skilful, existing lord). vyānaśī = vi + ānaśī, 'pervading' (uncertain). dharmaṇā rendered 'ordinance' (glossary open point on dharman; not 'dharma').
lines_deva: विश्वा धामानि विश्वचक्ष ऋभ्वसः प्रभोष्टे सतः परि यन्ति केतवः
व्यानशी पवसे सोम धर्मणा पतिर्विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि
lines_iast: viśvā dhāmāni viśvacakṣa ṛbhvasaḥ prabhoṣṭe sataḥ pari yanti ketavaḥ
vyānaśī pavase soma dharmaṇā patirviśvasya bhuvanasya rājasi

hindi: शुद्ध होने वाले ने आकाश से उज्ज्वल गर्जन के समान महान वैश्वानर प्रकाश को उत्पन्न किया।
english: The clarifying one begot from heaven, like bright thunder, the great Vaiśvānara light.
notes: na here is the simile particle (= iva); citram na tanyatum 'like bright thunder'. Syntax of citram is uncertain (it may qualify the light).

hindi: हे शुद्ध होने वाले, तुम्हारा रस, उल्लास, हे राजन्, हानि से मुक्त, भेड़ के बाल की छन्नी में से बहता है।
english: O clarifying one, your rasa, exhilaration, O king, free from harm, flows through the strainer of sheep's fleece.
notes: a-ducchunaḥ 'without misfortune' is the usual reading; ducchuna is obscure. vāram avyam: strainer of sheep's fleece.

words.gloss: for seeing the light of heaven

hindi: शुद्ध होने वाले, तुम्हारा रस, कौशल, दीप्तिमान होकर चमकता है; समस्त प्रकाश, सूर्य के प्रकाश को देखने के लिए।
english: The rasa of you, the clarifying one, skill, shines forth bright; all light, for the seeing of the light of heaven.
notes: Line b has no finite verb; translated as a fragment. dakṣaḥ in apposition to rasaḥ.
lines_deva: पवमानस्य ते रसो दक्षो वि राजति द्युमान्
lines_iast: pavamānasya te raso dakṣo vi rājati dyumān

hindi: जब गायों के समान तेज़, चमकते, दौड़ने वाले आगे बढ़े, काली त्वचा को दूर मारते हुए।
english: When, like cows, the swift, shining, speeding ones strode forth, smiting away the dark skin.
notes: na is the simile particle (= iva). The subject (the swift ones) is not named.
lines_deva: प्र यद्गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः
lines_iast: pra yadgāvo na bhūrṇayastveṣā ayāso akramuḥ

hindi: कल्याण के दुर्गम सेतु के पार; हम नियमहीन दस्यु को जीतें।
english: We [unclear] beyond the bridge of well-being, hard to approach; may we overcome the lawless Dasyu.
notes: ati manāmahe: the meaning of manāmahe with ati is doubtful (omitted in Hindi, [unclear] in English); the construction of setum and suvitasya is uncertain. Low confidence.

hindi: शुद्ध होने वाले, बलवान की ध्वनि, वर्षा के समान, सुनाई देती है; बिजलियाँ आकाश में चलती हैं।
english: The sound of the clarifying, vigorous one, as of rain, is heard; the lightnings move in heaven.

hindi: यहाँ शुद्ध होकर बहो, महान पोषण के साथ, गायों से भरपूर, हे बूँद, सोने से भरपूर, घोड़ों से भरपूर, हे सोम, वीरों से भरपूर।
english: Flow clear hither [with] great refreshment, rich in cattle, O drop, rich in gold, rich in horses, O Soma, rich in heroes.
notes: 'with' is supplied: iṣam is accusative after pavasva. gomat etc. are taken with iṣam.

hindi: हे सब देखने वाले, शुद्ध होकर बहो; दोनों महान लोकों को भर दो, जैसे उषा, सूर्य किरणों से।
english: Flow clear, O all-seeing one; fill the two great worlds, like Dawn, the sun, with rays.
notes: Line b: na is the simile particle placed after sūryaḥ; uṣāḥ and sūryaḥ taken together as the comparison. viśvacarṣaṇe may also mean 'lord of all peoples'. viśvacarṣaṇa ā is viśvacarṣaṇe + ā by regular Vedic sandhi (-e + ā gives -a ā), not a typo.
lines_deva: पवस्व विश्वचर्षण आ मही रोदसी पृण
lines_iast: pavasva viśvacarṣaṇa ā mahī rodasī pṛṇa

hindi: हे सोम, आश्रय देने वाली धारा से हमारे चारों ओर सब ओर से बहो, जैसे नमी ऊँचे स्थान तक।
english: Flow around us from all sides with the sheltering stream, O Soma, like moisture to the high place.
notes: raseva = rasā iva; rasā may be moisture or the name of a river (uncertain); viṣṭapa 'high place, summit'. sarā is the imperative sara with printed Vedic lengthening. Low confidence.
lines_deva: परि नः शर्मयन्त्या धारया सोम विश्वतः
lines_iast: pari naḥ śarmayantyā dhārayā soma viśvataḥ

hindi: तेज़ी से चारों ओर बहो, हे महान विचार वाले, प्रिय धाम के साथ, जहाँ देवगण ने ऐसा कहा।
english: Swift, flow around, O one of great thought, with the dear realm, where the gods spoke thus.
notes: bṛhanmate = bṛhat-mate (voc. of bṛhat-mati); iti bruvan quotes nothing in the text; pari ... priyeṇa dhāmnā is read 'around with the dear realm'.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. pari-√kṛ
m. nom. sg. pres. part. caus. √yat

hindi: अपरिष्कृत को परिष्कृत करते हुए, लोगों के लिए पोषण भेजते हुए, आकाश से वर्षा को चारों ओर बहाओ।
english: Preparing the unprepared, sending on refreshments for the people, flow the rain from heaven all around.
notes: pariṣkṛṇvan aniṣkṛtam is one token in the print (pariṣkṛṇvannaniṣkṛtaṃ). srava with accusative vṛṣṭim 'cause the rain to flow'.

hindi: यह वही है जो आकाश से तेज़ चलने वाला छन्ने में बह निकला, नदी की लहर।
english: This is he who, swift-going, from heaven, flowed forth in the filter, the wave of the river.
notes: ūrmā: the form (nominative 'wave', or an instrumental) is uncertain; here in apposition to the subject. pavitra ā = pavitre ā by sandhi.
lines_deva: अयँ स यो दिवस्परि रघुयामा पवित्र आ
lines_iast: aya~ sa yo divaspari raghuyāmā pavitra ā

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √dhā
m. nom. sg. pres. part. vi-√cakṣ
m. nom. sg. pres. part. caus. vi-√ruc

hindi: निचोड़ा गया वह छन्ने की ओर जाता है, बल से दीप्ति धारण करता हुआ, चारों ओर देखता हुआ, चमकाता हुआ।
english: The pressed one goes to the filter, taking on brilliance by might, looking about, making shine.
notes: pavitra ā = pavitre ā by sandhi.
lines_deva: सुत एति पवित्र आ त्विषिं दधान ओजसा
lines_iast: suta eti pavitra ā tviṣiṃ dadhāna ojasā

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. desid. (uncertain)

hindi: पाने की इच्छा करता हुआ, दूर से और निकट से भी, निचोड़ा गया; इन्द्र के लिए मधु उँड़ेला जाता है।
english: Wishing to win, from far and also from near, the pressed one; for Indra the sweet drink is poured.
notes: ā-vivāsan: desiderative of √vas 'to seek to win / to serve'; the object is not stated. sutaḥ and madhu do not agree in gender; taken as separate clauses.

hindi: मिलती हुई वे गूँज उठीं; पत्थरों से वे भूरे को, बूँद को, इन्द्र के पीने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।
english: The converging ones sounded; with stones they impel the tawny one, the drop, for Indra to drink.
notes: The converging ones (feminine plural) are not named in the text.

hindi: उज्ज्वल वे, बहनें, कुटुम्बिनियाँ, सूर्य को, स्वामी को, महान बूँद को प्रेरित करती हैं; वे महानता की कामना करने वाली।
english: The bright ones, the sisters, the kinswomen, impel the sun, the lord, the great drop; the ones desiring greatness.
notes: sūram: sūra 'sun, luminary' (kept apart from śūra 'hero'); usrayaḥ may mean cows or rays. mahīyuvaḥ is uncertain (mahī 'great' or 'earth'). Low confidence.

hindi: हे शुद्ध होने वाले, हर दीप्ति के साथ, देव, देवगण के लिए निचोड़े गए, सब धनों में प्रवेश करो।
english: O clarifying one, with every radiance, the god, pressed for the gods, enter into all the goods.

hindi: यहाँ, हे शुद्ध होने वाले, उत्तम स्तुति, वर्षा, देवगण के लिए सेवा; पोषण के लिए संयत होकर शुद्ध बहो।
english: Hither, O clarifying one, good praise, rain, service for the gods; flow clear for refreshment, restrained.
notes: Line a has no finite verb; ā may be taken with pavasva of line b ('flow hither'), and the accusatives as what he brings. Rendered as given. saṃyatam taken as 'restrained' (adverbial).
lines_deva: आ पवमान सुष्टुतिं वृष्टिं देवेभ्यो दुवः
lines_iast: ā pavamāna suṣṭutiṃ vṛṣṭiṃ devebhyo duvaḥ

hindi: लोगों का रक्षक, जागरूक अग्नि, उत्तम कौशल वाला, नए कल्याण के लिए उत्पन्न हुआ। घृत-मुख वाला, महान, आकाश को छूने वाले के द्वारा, दीप्तिमान रूप से चमकता है, भरतों के लिए उज्ज्वल।
english: The guardian of the people, the watchful Agni, of good skill, was born for new well-being. Ghee-faced, by the great heaven-touching [one], he shines forth brightly, bright for the Bharatas.

text_flags.why: possible: stem divispṛś 'heaven-touching'; ṣ printed for ś

notes: bṛhatā divispṛśā has no noun; the noun (perhaps a flame or light) is not given, so a short [one] is supplied. dyumat is not split (-mat).
lines_deva: जनस्य गोपा अजनिष्ट जागृविरग्निः सुदक्षः सुविताय नव्यसे
घृतप्रतीको बृहता दिविस्पृषा द्युमद्वि भाति भरतेभ्यः शुचिः
lines_iast: janasya gopā ajaniṣṭa jāgṛviragniḥ sudakṣaḥ suvitāya navyase
ghṛtapratīko bṛhatā divispṛṣā dyumadvi bhāti bharatebhyaḥ śuciḥ

words.gram: m. acc. sg. perf. part. mid. √śri
m. nom. sg. pres. part. pass. √math

hindi: हे अग्नि, तुम्हें अंगिरसों ने गुप्त में रखा हुआ पाया, हर वन में विश्राम करते हुए। वह तुम मथे जाते हुए उत्पन्न होते हो, महान बल; वे तुम्हें बल का पुत्र कहते हैं, हे अंगिरस।
english: You, O Agni, the Aṅgirases found placed in secret, resting in each wood. That one, you are born when churned, great strength; they call you the son of strength, O Aṅgiras.
notes: añchiśriyāṇam = an śiśriyāṇam by sandhi (avindan + śiśriyāṇam). sa is a resumptive pronoun with a second-person verb. saho mahat taken as 'great strength' in apposition.
lines_deva: स जायसे मथ्यमानः सहो महत्वामाहुः सहसस्पुत्रमङ्गिरः
lines_iast: sa jāyase mathyamānaḥ saho mahatvāmāhuḥ sahasasputramaṅgiraḥ

hindi: यज्ञ के ध्वज को, प्रथम को, आगे स्थापित अग्नि को, मनुष्य तीन स्थानों वाले आसन में प्रज्वलित करते हैं। इन्द्र के साथ, देवगण के साथ, एक रथ पर, वह होता, उत्तम शक्ति वाला, यज्ञ के लिए कुशासन पर बैठ गया।
english: Men kindle in the threefold seat Agni, the banner of the sacrifice, the first, placed in front. With Indra, with the gods, on one chariot, he, the Hotṛ priest of good power, sat down on the sacred grass for the sacrifice.
notes: sīdanni = sīdat ni. The subject sa of line b is not named in the text (Agni by context).
lines_deva: यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरोहितमग्निं नरस्त्रिषधस्थे समिन्धते
इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथँ स बर्हिषि सीदन्नि होता यजथाय सुक्रतुः
lines_iast: yajñasya ketuṃ prathamaṃ purohitamagniṃ narastriṣadhasthe samindhate
indreṇa devaiḥ saratha~ sa barhiṣi sīdanni hotā yajathāya sukratuḥ

hindi: हे मित्र और वरुण, ऋत को बढ़ाने वालो, यह सोम तुम दोनों के लिए निचोड़ा गया है; यहाँ मेरी पुकार ही सुनो।
english: This Soma has been pressed for you two, O Mitra and Varuṇa, increasers of truth; hear my call here indeed.
lines_deva: अयं वां मित्रावरुणा सुतः सोम ऋतावृधा
lines_iast: ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā sutaḥ soma ṛtāvṛdhā

hindi: दोनों राजा, हानि न पहुँचाने वाले, दृढ़, सर्वोच्च आसन में, हज़ार खम्भों वाले में, पहुँचते हैं।
english: The two kings, unharming, attain, in the firm, highest seat, in the thousand-pillared [one].
notes: āśāte is kept as printed and read from √aś 'attain'; the construction is uncertain. sahasrasthūṇe is taken with sadasi (the seat).

hindi: वे दो सम्राट, घी की आहुति वाले, दोनों आदित्य, दानु के स्वामी, अविचलित रूप से साथ रहते हैं।
english: Those two sovereigns, whose libation is ghee, the two Ādityas, lords of dānu, keep company unswervingly.
notes: dānu (fluid, gift) is left untranslated; the gods are not named in the text. sacete has no object; rendered 'keep company'.

hindi: अपराजित इन्द्र ने दधीचि की हड्डियों से वृत्रों को, नौ और नब्बे को, मारा।
english: Indra, unrepulsed, slew with the bones of Dadhīci the Vṛtras, nine and ninety.

hindi: इच्छा करता हुआ, घोड़े का जो सिर पर्वतों में छिपा था, उसे उसने शर्यणावत् में पाया।
english: Desiring the head of the horse which was hidden in the mountains, he found that at Śaryaṇāvat.
notes: The subject of vidat is not named in the text. Śaryaṇāvat is kept as a name; vidat is imperfect/injunctive.

hindi: यहाँ ही उन्होंने गौ के नाम का, त्वष्टा के गुप्त नाम का, विचार किया; इस प्रकार चन्द्रमा के घर में।
english: Here indeed they thought of the name of the cow, the hidden [name] of Tvaṣṭṛ; thus in the house of the moon.
notes: Obscure verse: the relation of goḥ and tvaṣṭuḥ to nāma is uncertain, and amanvata is read 'they thought of'. Low confidence.

hindi: तुम दोनों के लिए, इस विचार की यह पुरानी स्तुति, हे इन्द्र और अग्नि, उत्पन्न हुई, जैसे बादल से वर्षा।
english: This ancient praise of this thought, for you two, O Indra and Agni, was born, like rain from a cloud.
notes: vām asya manmanaḥ: genitive 'of this thought' kept literal.

hindi: गायक की पुकार सुनो, हे इन्द्र और अग्नि; स्तुतियों को स्वीकार करो; स्वामी होकर विचारों को बढ़ाओ।
english: Hear the call of the singer, O Indra and Agni; accept the songs; being lords, make the thoughts swell.
notes: vanatam 'accept, favour' (√van); pipyatam 'make swell, nourish'.

hindi: हमें पाप के लिए न सौंपो, हे वीरो इन्द्र और अग्नि, और न आरोप के लिए; हमें निन्दा के लिए न सौंपो।
english: Do not [give us over] to evil, O heroes Indra and Agni, nor to accusation; do not give us over to reproach.
notes: The verb rīradhatam of line b is understood in line a. narā 'two heroes' is dual.

hindi: शुद्ध होकर बहो, कौशल को सिद्ध करने वाले, देवगण के पीने के लिए, हे भूरे; मरुतों के लिए, वायु के लिए उल्लास।
english: Flow clear, accomplisher of skill, for the gods to drink, O tawny one; exhilaration for the Maruts, for Vāyu.
notes: dakṣasādhanaḥ printed with -o by sandhi; nominative (or vocative) 'accomplisher of skill'.

hindi: देवगण के साथ बलवान चमकता है, कवि, प्रिय, आसन पर; शुद्ध होने वाला, अबाध्य।
english: Together with the gods the mighty one shines, the seer, dear, on the seat; the clarifying one, inviolable.
lines_deva: सं देवैः शोभते वृषा कविर्योनावधि प्रियः
lines_iast: saṃ devaiḥ śobhate vṛṣā kaviryonāvadhi priyaḥ
